h1: A cannabis shop near you in Pattaya
intro: If you searched for a cannabis shop near you in Pattaya, Labs Cannabis stands at 32 Pattaya 13 Alley in South Pattaya and is listed on Google Maps as LABS DISPENSARY. Flower is handed over in the shop, to adults aged 20 or older who hold a prescription issued in Thailand. This page tells you how to check you are at the right door and what happens once you are inside.

sections.h2: Make sure it is the right shop
sections.body: Pattaya 13 Alley has more than one dispensary, and the neighbouring lane carries a similar name, so it is worth checking two things before you walk in. The address on the sign should read 32 Pattaya 13 Alley, and the Google listing should say LABS DISPENSARY with the same phone number printed on this site. If either does not match, you are at a different business.

A member of staff asks what you are after, opens the jars and lets you look and smell before you decide. Identification showing you are 20 or older and a prescription issued in Thailand are checked first. Nothing is reserved, paid for or arranged through this website; the counter does all of it. Asking on WhatsApp +66 66 080 6784 before you set off saves a trip across town.

Since 26 June 2025 cannabis flower has been a controlled herb in Thailand. It is dispensed in person, in the shop, to adults aged 20 or older who present a prescription issued by a licensed practitioner in Thailand; such a prescription covers a course of up to 30 days. Prescriptions issued abroad are not accepted, and flower may not be taken out of the country. This paragraph states the rule and offers to arrange nothing.

faq.q: How do I know I am at Labs Cannabis and not a neighbour?
faq.a: Check the street number 32 on Pattaya 13 Alley and the LABS DISPENSARY sign, and compare the phone number with the one on this site. Several dispensaries share the area and one nearby lane has a similar name.

faq.q: Who may buy cannabis flower in Thailand?
faq.a: Adults aged 20 or older who hold a prescription issued inside Thailand. Prescriptions from other countries are not accepted, and the handover happens in person, in the shop.

closing: Open the Google Maps listing for the route to 32 Pattaya 13 Alley, or ask on WhatsApp +66 66 080 6784 what is in the shop today and how to find the door.
